name: Xingyao Wang
bio: Xingyao Wang is a co-founder of All Hands AI and its chief AI officer, building the open-source software agent OpenHands. They are also a PhD candidate in computer science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. Wang is first author of the OpenHands platform paper and of CodeAct, which uses executable code as the action space for LLM agents.
known_for: Lead author of the OpenHands agent platform
First author of CodeAct executable-code agents
Co-author of SWE-Gym for training software agents
